description: This file defines a base class for an RQL parser using the akka.parboiled2 library, including methods for parsing literals, strings, numbers, and escape sequences, with detailed rules for token recognition and string building.

classes.name: RqlParserBase
classes.description: A base parser class for RQL syntax, providing rules for parsing literals, strings, numbers, and escape sequences.

methods.name: Literal
methods.description: Parses literals including numbers, strings, booleans, and null.

methods.name: CharactersInQuotes
methods.description: Parses characters within double quotes, including escape sequences.

methods.name: CharactersInSingleQuotes
methods.description: Parses characters within single quotes, including escape sequences.

methods.name: EscapedChar
methods.description: Handles escape sequences within double-quoted strings.

methods.name: SingleQuoteEscapedChar
methods.description: Handles escape sequences within single-quoted strings.
